JSON statement receipts = Charge for services / Sales + Interest revenue + Miscellaneous / Merchandise Sales / Grants. Per fund: Charge for services / Sales 7,669,568 + 1,669,211 + 3,007,588 + 1,248,805 = 13,595,172; Interest revenue 499,541 + Water - + 90,147 + 21 = 589,709; Miscellaneous / Merchandise Sales / Grants (1,413,385) + 653,502 + (76,442) + 5,914 = (830,411) (printed signs kept, as on the JSON statement line). 13,595,172 + 589,709 - 830,411 = 13,354,470 = statement total = gap. Check: 0 + 13,354,470 = 13,354,470.
